interface Vlan200
  description APP_SERVERS
  no shutdown
  mtu 9000
  vrf member TENANT1
  no ip redirects
  ip address 10.20.0.2/24
  ip address 10.20.1.2/24 secondary
  ip access-group ACL_APP_IN in

  ip router ospf 1 area 0.0.0.10

  ip arp timeout 300

  hsrp 200
    preempt
